description: This file defines additional methods (extensions) for handling Kubernetes events within the v1beta1 API version, including creating, updating, and patching events with specific namespace handling.

classes.name: EventExpansion
classes.description: Interface for manually adding extra methods to the EventInterface, specifically for creating, updating, and patching events within specific namespaces.

methods.name: CreateWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new event in the specified namespace, returning the server's response or an error.

methods.name: UpdateWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Updates an existing event, returning the server's response or an error.

methods.name: PatchWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Patches an existing event with provided data, returning the server's response or an error.
